scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!/pnpm/.test(ua)){console.error('Use pnpm (npx pnpm@10)'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function rm(p){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}} for (const p of ['apps/web/dist','coverage','.nyc_output']) rm(p); for (const d of fs.readdirSync('packages')){rm(path.join('packages',d,'dist'));rm(path.join('packages',d,'coverage'));}"
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @fix-my-print/formats-3mf run test && pnpm --filter @fix-my-print/repo-guard run test
scripts.test:differential: pnpm --filter @fix-my-print/knowledge-compiler run test -- wikiDifferential && pnpm --filter @fix-my-print/geometry-manifold run test -- meshDifferential
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:boundary && pnpm verify:no-python && pnpm verify:acceptance-lock && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:security && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e:public && pnpm test:e2e:private && pnpm test:network && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:repeatability && git diff --check
scripts.ci: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:web && git diff --check
